scope: Full-original inspection of four representative refusals; no assignment relaxed

observations.observation: Four natural legs, no udder or fifth limb. Reference impala counter joins both hind-leg owners in one component; winner-only assignment loses the separately painted far hind leg.
observations.proposedOwner: existing distinct hind chain, one-to-one assignment required

observations.observation: Large open lower jaw and species teeth; reference bass head/jaw exist but no reference front component is counted.
observations.proposedOwner: existing head/jaw, reference-paint and target-overlap evidence required

observations.observation: Raised continuous natural tail. Chimpanzee reference is tailless and offers no tail owner.
observations.proposedOwner: requires independently qualified tailed reference; never assign to head or exempt as extra

observations.observation: Natural broad hind swimming leg; both hind legs collapse to one counted reference component.
observations.proposedOwner: existing separate hind leg chains, not a wing/body exemption
